description: This walk explores Lainshaw Woods in Stewarton, East Ayrshire. It's a lovely place for an easy stroll with waterside paths along Annick Water, peaceful woodland and countryside views to enjoy. There are also signposts to highlight the variety of wildlife you can see on the walk. The paths are well maintained and there are benches along the way for a rest.You can continue your walking in the area by heading east to pick up theWhitelee Wind Farm Walk.
